title: EXP-Bench: Can AI Conduct AI Research Experiments?
authors_zh: Patrick Tser Jern Kon, Qiuyi Ding, Jiachen Liu, Xinyi Zhu, Jingjia Peng, Jiarong Xing, Yibo Huang, Yiming Qiu, Jayanth Srinivasa, Myungjin Lee, Mosharaf Chowdhury, Matei Zaharia, Ang Chen
paper_type_zh: 端到端 AI 研究实验的可执行智能体基准
best_for_zh: 需要评测智能体能否完成完整机器学习实验流程的研究者。
one_line: EXP-Bench turns 51 AI papers into 461 executable research-experiment tasks requiring agents to design, implement, run, and analyze experiments.
EXP-Bench 从 51 篇 AI 论文构建 461 个可执行研究实验任务，要求智能体完成设计、实现、运行与结果分析。
why: It evaluates research agents through runnable experimental artifacts rather than a prose account of a plan.
inclusion_reason: EXP-Bench releases executable research-experiment episodes with structured intermediate artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing research-agent benchmarks often evaluate literature question answering, hypothesis generation, or local code completion and do not show whether a system can complete a real experiment. AI research experiments require understanding a question, formulating a testable hypothesis, modifying multiple code modules, configuring data and hyperparameters, running training, and interpreting results. Failure at any stage can make the experiment non-executable. Manually constructing such tasks from papers and repositories is also too expensive for scalable, reproducible evaluation.

EXP-Bench introduces a semi-automated construction pipeline that organizes 461 research tasks from 51 top AI papers and their open-source code. Each task provides a research question and incomplete starter code and asks an agent to design, implement, execute, and analyze an experiment, with code execution and stage-level scoring checking the complete research process.

现有科研 agent benchmark 多评测文献问答、假设生成或局部代码补全，不能说明系统能否完成一项真实实验。AI 研究实验需要理解问题、提出可检验假设、修改多个代码模块、配置数据与超参数、运行训练并解释结果；任何环节失败都会使实验不可执行。人工从论文和仓库构造此类任务又成本高，难以形成规模化、可重复的评测。

EXP-Bench 提出半自动数据构建流程，从 51 篇顶级 AI 论文及开源代码中整理 461 个研究任务。每题提供研究问题和不完整 starter code，要求 agent 依次设计、实现、执行和分析实验，并通过代码运行及阶段评分检查完整科研流程。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is to decompose paper experiments into executable agent tasks with stage-level scoring. EXP-Bench’s 461 records derive from 51 papers and preserve research questions, experimental goals, starter code, components to complete, execution configurations, expected analyses, and grading information. A semi-automated pipeline extracts hypotheses, variables, data, models, and metrics from papers, aligns them with official repository files, and uses human review to confirm fidelity and executability. Evaluation provides sub-scores for design, implementation, execution, and analysis while also requiring complete experimental success, localizing failures to specific research stages rather than relying only on a final textual judge.

核心贡献是把论文实验拆成可执行、可分阶段评分的 agent 任务。EXP-Bench 的 461 条记录源自 51 篇论文，保留研究问题、实验目标、starter code、需要补全的组件、运行配置、预期分析和判分信息。半自动 pipeline 先从论文抽取假设、变量、数据、模型和指标，再与官方仓库文件对齐，最后由人工检查任务是否忠实且可运行。评测既给出设计、实现、执行和分析等子分数，也要求完整实验成功，因而可将失败定位到具体研究步骤，而非只用最终文本 judge。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select papers and repositories: Influential AI papers are filtered for open-source implementations, installable dependencies, and experiments that can be rerun within controlled budgets.
  1. Extract experimental structure: A model identifies research questions, hypotheses, variables, data, models, metrics, and expected conclusions from papers and maps them to repository code and configuration files.
  1. Generate task assets: Key experimental components are removed or rewritten to create incomplete starter code, explicit goals, and execution instructions, with dependencies, paths, and base scripts automatically checked.
  1. Validate and score: Humans review fidelity and trial-run tasks. Agent outputs receive separate scores for design, implementation, executability, and analysis, while complete success requires every stage to pass.

1. 选择论文与仓库： 筛选有开源实现、依赖可安装且实验可在受控预算内重跑的高影响 AI 论文。
  1. 抽取实验结构： 由模型从论文识别研究问题、假设、自变量、数据、模型、指标和预期结论，再映射到仓库代码与配置文件。
  1. 生成任务资产： 删除或改写关键实验组件，形成不完整 starter code、明确目标和运行说明；自动检查依赖、路径与基础脚本。
  1. 验证与评分： 人工复核忠实度并试运行；agent 输出按实验设计、代码实现、可执行性和结果分析分别评分，只有全部环节通过才计完整成功。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors run 461 tasks with leading LLM agents such as OpenHands and IterativeAgent. Individual dimensions such as experimental design or implementation occasionally reach 20%–35%, yet only 0.5% of tasks result in complete executable experiments, showing that isolated capabilities do not automatically compose into a research loop. Tasks span 51 papers and preserve stepwise procedures, enabling statistical localization of failures rather than a single aggregate score. This establishes a large gap between current agents and complete research experimentation, but outcomes depend on compute resources and timeout budgets, so the 0.5% figure must remain tied to the paper’s setup.

作者在 OpenHands、IterativeAgent 等主流 LLM agent 上运行 461 个任务。单独的实验设计或实现维度有时可达到 20%–35%，但真正完成可执行端到端实验的比例仅 0.5%，说明分项能力不能自动组合为科研闭环。任务覆盖 51 篇论文，并保留逐步实验程序，支持对失败位置做统计，而非只观察一个总分。该证据证明当前 agent 与完整研究实验之间差距很大，但实验成本、GPU 资源和运行超时会影响结果，0.5% 不能脱离论文的预算设置解释。

title: Novelty
新意
html: ResearchCodeBench focuses on local implementation of novel modules, while PaperBench approaches full reproduction but often requires expensive holistic judging. EXP-Bench decomposes complete experiments into multiple executable intermediate objectives and uses a semi-automated pipeline to scale extraction to 461 tasks. Its novelty is not simply asking agents to do research; it establishes a design–implementation–execution–analysis data contract that reveals whether failures arise from hypotheses, code, environments, or interpretation. The evaluated models and agent scaffolds are not the main innovation.

ResearchCodeBench 聚焦论文中新模块的局部实现，PaperBench 更接近完整复现但常依赖高成本综合评审。EXP-Bench 的变化是将完整实验拆成多个仍可执行的中间目标，并用半自动 pipeline 从论文和仓库规模化提取 461 个任务。其新意不只是“让 agent 做研究”，而是建立设计—实现—执行—分析的阶段化数据合同，使研究者能判断失败究竟来自假设、代码、环境还是结论解释。模型和 agent scaffold 并非论文主要创新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Resource sensitivity: Training experiments depend on GPUs, runtime, and random seeds, so timeouts may be mistaken for research-capability failures. Reuse must report resource budgets and variance across runs.
  1. Task fidelity: Semi-automated extraction can simplify hypotheses or omit implicit configurations, and human review cannot fully prove equivalence to original experiments. Paper-to-task lineage and review records should be preserved.
  1. Subjective evaluation: Design and analysis cannot be fully programmatically graded, so some scoring relies on rubrics or judges. Important conclusions require human audits and should not be conflated with execution scores.

1. 资源敏感： 训练型实验受 GPU、运行时间和随机种子影响；超时可能被误判为研究能力失败。复用需报告资源预算和多次运行方差。
  1. 任务忠实度： 半自动抽取可能简化论文假设或遗漏隐含配置，人工复核也难证明任务等价于原实验。应保留 paper-to-task lineage 和审校记录。
  1. 评测主观项： 设计与分析阶段难以完全程序化，部分评分仍依赖 rubric 或 judge。关键结论需人工抽检，不能与代码执行分数混合解释。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Research-agent evaluation: Fix GPU, time, and network access and report design, implementation, execution, analysis, and complete success separately so high sub-scores do not hide end-to-end failure.
  1. Process supervision: Convert stage outputs, compiler logs, experiment results, and failure reasons into trajectory labels for planners or stage verifiers, with terminal rewards grounded primarily in actual execution.
  1. Data expansion: Reuse extraction, code alignment, component removal, trial execution, and human review for new papers. Experiments requiring private data, massive compute, or unreplayable services should be excluded rather than replaced by textual judges.

1. 科研 agent 评测： 固定 GPU、时间和网络访问，分别报告设计、实现、执行、分析及完整成功率，避免用较高子分数掩盖端到端失败。
  1. 过程监督： 将阶段输出、编译日志、实验结果和失败原因转为 trajectory labels，训练 planner 或阶段 verifier；最终奖励需以真实运行结果为主。
  1. 数据扩展： 对新论文复用抽取—代码对齐—挖空—试运行—人工复核流程。若实验依赖私有数据、巨量算力或无法重放的服务，应排除而非用文本 judge 替代执行。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: EXP-Bench tests whether agents can complete an AI experiment from hypothesis through result analysis rather than merely write a research-code fragment.
  2. Method takeaway: Paper-structure extraction, repository alignment, starter-code construction, trial runs, and stage scoring are central.
  3. Data takeaway: It contains 461 tasks from 51 papers with research questions, code, configurations, procedures, and evaluation assets.
  4. Evidence anchor: Individual stages reach about 20%–35%, while complete executable success is only 0.5%, within compute-budget limits.
  5. Reuse decision: It suits research-process supervision; lineage must be preserved and execution scores separated from subjective rubrics.

1. 一句话定位： EXP-Bench 检查 agent 能否完成从假设到结果分析的完整 AI 实验，而不只是写一段研究代码。
  2. 方法抓手： 论文结构抽取、仓库对齐、starter code 构造、试运行与分阶段评分是核心。
  3. 数据抓手： 461 个任务来自 51 篇论文，记录研究问题、代码、配置、步骤和评测资产。
  4. 证据锚点： 单阶段约 20%–35%，完整可执行成功仅 0.5%，结论受算力预算约束。
  5. 复用决定： 适合科研过程监督；必须保存 lineage，分离执行分数和主观 rubric。
